item.title: US 30-Year Bonds Reverse Gains From Treasury’s Buyback Surprise
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The rise in real, or inflation-adjusted, yields suggests that investors are demanding a higher premium to buy the government’s debt to compensate for the building risks. “Given the size of the deficit and some crowding out effect that AI has had, this is the equivalent of tossing paper towel into a tsunami,” said George Catrambone, head of fixed income at DWS Americas.
